realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Technocrat
primary.description: Optimises for efficiency; people-politics is noise to filter out.
primary.guiding_promise: I solve what others accept — with data, not drama.
primary.shadow_description: Optimizes the system so completely that the people inside it become variables, not lives.

secondary.label: Inventor
secondary.description: Curiosity-led; comfortable deciding by experiment rather than certainty.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will find a new way where the old ways have run out.
secondary.shadow_description: Abandons every idea the moment a shinier one appears, and finishes nothing.

wheel.central_question: Should we optimize the system, or tend to the person?

growth.label: Inventor
growth.description: Curiosity-led; comfortable deciding by experiment rather than certainty.
growth.guiding_promise: I will find a new way where the old ways have run out.
growth.shadow_description: Abandons every idea the moment a shinier one appears, and finishes nothing.

other_ally.label: Oracle
other_ally.description: Notices what hasn't happened yet — through a mind that sees connections others miss.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will speak the pattern I see, even when no one wants to hear it yet.
other_ally.shadow_description: Mistakes a hunch for a prophecy, and loses the trust of anyone who asks for proof.

quarter.label: Messenger
quarter.description: Bridges people and truths that wouldn't otherwise connect.
quarter.guiding_promise: I carry only what is real, to those who need it most.
quarter.shadow_description: Carries everyone else's message so faithfully that their own voice goes quiet.

opposite.label: Healer
opposite.description: Cares deeply; others' suffering is what they fear most.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will ease what hurts, and protect what heals.
opposite.shadow_description: Absorbs everyone else's pain until there's nothing left to tend their own.

realmmate.label: Democrat
realmmate.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
realmmate.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.compatible_text: Democrat · Bureaucrat — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
